signals.fact: A Houthi missile strike killed 50 security recruits in Yemen as of 2026-10-20, amid a wider escalation that has included Houthi strikes on Saudi airports and Saudi-led airstrikes on Houthi positions.
signals.lede: Houthi missile strike kills 50 security recruits in Yemen
signals.soWhat: Signals a sustained, multi-front conflict with regional spillover, raising the odds of further attacks on civilian infrastructure and Red Sea shipping.

signals.fact: Nationwide cost-of-living demonstrations in France turned violent on October 16-17, with looting in Paris, Lyon, and Marseille, the Limoges town hall set ablaze, at least 1,800 arrests, 150 officers injured, and one demonstrator dead.
signals.lede: Cost-of-living protests turn violent with looting, 1,800 arrests
signals.soWhat: Points to a volatile pre-electoral period, with the convergence of student and Yellow Vest movements raising the odds of sustained unrest.
